keySentence: He ran away as fast as he could.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Peter was so afraid. He ran very very fast. He saw the garden gate. He ran away as fast as he could.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Peter was terrified of Mr. McGregor. He wished he had listened to his mother. But now he had to escape with all his strength. He ran past the tool shed and the flower pots. He ran away as fast as he could toward the gate. He squeezed through the gate and was finally free.
